items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Della was her name at the Copperwayo

ctx.x: There was a lady… there was so many brothers working in the Metropoll, this lady was cooking soul food. She had the best collard greens in town. You could step right out of the Metropoll and go across the street. Della was her name at the Copperwayo and eat you some good soul food dinner.
That was, the Metropoll was a strange place to play because everybody was across the scene. I mean you were spread out. There was no…you were all right over the bar.
